method: Paper folding and cutting: unfold with reflections
steps: Paper folded top half down, then right half to left: folded piece is the bottom-left quarter
Cuts: E near left edge at the top (near the horizontal fold), reversed E near the bottom next to the vertical fold
Unfold vertical fold: E at left edge -> reversed E at right edge; reversed E near centre bottom -> E beside it
Unfold horizontal fold: marks near the horizontal centre line duplicate above; bottom-centre pair duplicates at top-centre
Result: E,E on left middle; reversed E pair on right middle; reversed E + E pairs at top and bottom centre = option B
Some fruits are flowers and all flowers are garlands -> those fruits are garlands: I follows
Vegetables need not overlap flowers or garlands: II and III do not follow
